source_text:
19.3,4 ̓Εξαποστείλαι σοι βοήθειαν ἐξ
ἁγίου, καὶ ἐκ Σιὼν ἀντελάβοιτό σου· μνησ θείη πάσης θυσίας σου, καὶ τὸ
ὁλοκαύτωμά σου πιανάτω.
̔Ρυσθήσει, φησὶν, εὐχαριστικῶς αὐτῷ προσάγων
θυσίαν πνευματικήν· τὸ πάσης πλῆθος ἐμφαίνει· ὀλίγης γὰρ οὐ μίμνηται. –
Πιαίνεται δὲ ὁλοκαύτωμα, ο ταν ο λῳ τῷ νοητῷ πυρὶ παραδοθῇ, τῷ πνεύματι· ε σται
δὲ τοῦτο, ο ταν οἱ προσφέροντες πνευματικοὶ τυγχάνωσιν.
pass_a_gloss: May-he-send to-you help out-of holy, and out-of Zion may-he-support you; may-he-remember of-all sacrifice of-you, and the whole-burnt-offering of-you let-him-fatten. You-will-be-delivered, he-says, thankfully to-him bringing sacrifice spiritual; the of-all multitude it-indicates; of-small for not he-remembers. Is-fattened and whole-burnt-offering, whenever to-whole the intelligible fire it-be-given-over, to-the spirit; will-be and this, whenever the offering spiritual they-happen-to-be.
pass_b_english: “May he send you help from the holy place, and from Zion may he support you; may he remember all your sacrifice, and may your whole-burnt-offering be fattened” (Psalm 19:3-4).

You will be delivered, he says, bringing to him thankfully a spiritual sacrifice; “all” indicates multitude, for he does not remember a small one. And a whole-burnt-offering is fattened when it is given over to the whole intelligible fire, the Spirit; and this will be when those who offer happen to be spiritual.

choices.english: may he remember all your sacrifice
choices.why: πάσης is all, indicating multitude. Not ‘remember a small sacrifice’.
rejected: may he remember a small sacrifice

choices.english: You will be delivered, bringing a spiritual sacrifice
choices.why: OCR ̔Ρυσθήσει as ῥυσθήσῃ, second person. Thankful spiritual offering, not a bloody cult.
rejected: he will seize a spiritual sacrifice
you will be delivered by a bloody offering

choices.term: ὅταν ὅλῳ τῷ νοητῷ πυρὶ παραδοθῇ, τῷ πνεύματι
choices.english: when it is given over to the whole intelligible fire, the Spirit
choices.why: νοητός is intelligible, not sensible. Fire identified as the Spirit. OCR ο ταν / ο λῳ.
rejected: when given to the whole mind without the Spirit
